title: OneDrive: pay-as-you-go storage beyond licensed quotas
summary: The briefing passes: its rollout dates, billing prerequisites, published prices and configuration controls are supported. The categorical assurance that enabling the service introduces no new data access is not stated in the Microsoft documentation and should be replaced with a narrower description.

claims.fix: Replace 'No new data access: the service changes how much a user's own OneDrive can hold, not who can read it' with 'Microsoft documents additional storage above licensed quotas; the cited setup documentation does not discuss changes to content-access permissions.' Keep the billing-region sentence.
